title: Good for a while and then repetitive
text: I don't know how it could be anything but repetitive - there is only so much you can do with cat toys. Our three meezers like more 'stuff on a string' but we were getting too many boxes with stuffed toys. NICE stuffed toys and very creative as for holidays or specials. And they are very well made and last but then they just run out of ideas and everything repeats. It is hard to keep smart cats entertained. This works but only for a while.
label: neutral
